page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.8-128 is an ARM-based compute instance built on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores operating at one thread per core, presenting 16 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading overhead. System memory is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB per core.

The platform utilizes the arm64 architecture with single-threaded core isolation, ensuring consistent execution timing by eliminating hyperthreading-related resource contention. The configuration includes no integrated local storage disks, requiring external network-attached block volumes for persistent data and root operating system installations. It contains zero GPU hardware accelerators and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With its 1:8 compute-to-memory profile, the instance is positioned toward memory-demanding deployments that benefit from ARM energy and resource efficiency. The architecture offers predictable performance density for memory-bound services. VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.8-128 is suitable for running in-memory caching services, mid-sized relational database management systems, containerized web backends, and software development toolchains targeted at ARM64 binaries.
description: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.8-128 is an ARM64 cloud instance powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs with a single thread per core, paired with 128.0 GB of memory to yield an allocation of 8.0 GB per core. This 1:8 compute-to-memory profile qualifies it for memory-intensive workloads. The instance operates without discrete hardware acceleration, featuring zero GPUs, and includes no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached storage volumes for persistent data retention. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. By leveraging dedicated, non-hyperthreaded ARM cores, the platform avoids noisy-neighbor contention at the core level while providing resource density and energy efficiency typical of the architecture. VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.8-128 is suited for memory-heavy applications, including in-memory datastores, relational databases, container orchestration nodes, and continuous integration pipelines targeting ARM environments.
